program_name: Bleap Ambassador Program (plus in-app Referrals Program)
application_conditions: Ambassador Program: unknown — the page is now only linked from the site footer as 'Ambassadors' → old.bleap.finance/about/ambassador-program (legacy host), not fetchable (client error 2026-11-05, provenance block 2026-11-24); no ambassador, affiliate or partner agreement among the 14 documents on bleap.finance/legal-agreements. Referrals Program: any user with a valid account shares a personal link; official 'Bleap Referrals Terms and Conditions' (updated 25 May 2026) read 2026-11-24 (German locale).
paid_action: Ambassador Program: unknown. Referrals Program (T&Cs 2026-05-25 + help centre): referred user registers via the link, completes KYC, is eligible to use Bleap, has no prior account, tops up by bank transfer (other methods ineligible) and makes at least three card payment transactions of a minimum amount — T&Cs: 'at least five euros (€5) each'; help centre: 'at least five euros (€10)' (internally inconsistent; the dated T&Cs govern: €5).
validation_conditions: Referrals Program: rewards credited after Bleap verifies the requirements; each person can be referred once; existing account holders ineligible; help centre: maximum five referral rewards per user (the T&Cs mention campaign 'limits' without figures); quasi-cash payments (gambling, gift cards, P2P) and crypto/wallet deposits excluded; rewards non-transferable; programme changeable or terminable without notice (T&Cs §8.1); immediate suspension/removal for abuse (§7). Ambassador Program conditions unknown.

commission.model_note: Unknown. Referral reward amounts are shown only on the in-app Rewards page ('currently available campaigns'); no figure is published on the pages read.

payout.method: Referrals: 'cash or equivalent rewards' credited to the referrer's Bleap account. Ambassador Program: unknown.

rules_note: Referrals T&Cs (updated 25 May 2026; legal entity not named in the text — footer '© Bleap LTD 2026', cookie/privacy policies name Bleap SIA; governing law not stated): links 'may not be sold, transferred, assigned, exchanged or used for commercial referral activity unless expressly permitted by Bleap'; publishing links 'through spam, paid ads, misleading promotions, unsolicited messages, or any unlawful channel' prohibited; fake accounts, self-referral, multiple accounts and threshold manipulation prohibited. A comparator website is commercial referral activity — not usable without Bleap's express permission. Help-centre page undated ('Updated over 2 weeks ago' on 2026-11-05 and 2026-11-24). Support agents cannot add or change campaigns manually.
allowed_countries_note: Referred users must pass KYC and, for the card-purchase condition, be card-eligible (EEA or Switzerland residents, restricted nationalities excluded).
